Treatment summary
Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred during a lane change, reporting neck pain, stiffness, and headache
consistent with whiplash-type loading. The mechanism of injury is well matched to the reported force of the crash. Over the
course of 29 visits, care consisted of manual therapy, range-of-motion exercises, and a progressive home exercise program.
Treatment followed a typical, expected course, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved and range of motion returned
toward normal. Cervical imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the injury, showing reduced range of motion,
muscle guarding, and tenderness on palpation. No prior injury to the cervical spine or surrounding soft tissue is known from the
patient's history or available records. Billing records reflect single, non-duplicated charges for each service rendered. At
discharge, the patient was improving and was instructed to continue the home exercise program as needed.
</page>
